Kavya Qureshi
Azure DevOps Engineer | Andheri East, Mumbai
kavya.qureshi528@example.com | +91 9166349684

Experienced Azure DevOps Engineer with a practical background in building and automating cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and platform reliability. Strong collaborator who drives cross-functional initiatives with measurable improvements in deployment frequency, lead time and cost optimization. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience

Nykaa — Apr 2025 - Present
Azure DevOps Engineer (Remote/On-site)
- Implemented Kubernetes-based deployment platform on Microsoft Azure, migrating three microservices to AKS and reducing deployment failures by 40% using Git-driven pipelines.
- Designed Terraform modules to provision networking, AKS clusters and managed identities, enabling reproducible environments and cutting environment setup time from days to under 2 hours.
- Automated release workflows with Git and PowerShell/Ansible scripts, improving deployment frequency by 3x and reducing rollback incidents by 50%.
- Collaborated via Confluence and cross-team runbooks to improve incident response; reduced mean time to recovery (MTTR) by 35%.

Medisure — May 2023 - Mar 2025
Cloud Engineer (Hybrid)
- Migrated legacy workloads to Microsoft Azure using Terraform, achieving 25% cost savings through reserved instances and right-sizing after metrics analysis.
- Built automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and Ansible, deploying consistent environments across dev, staging and prod and decreasing configuration drift to near zero.
- Developed PowerShell automation for routine maintenance and backups, reducing manual intervention by 60% and lowering human error rates.
- Maintained Linux-based application hosts and integrated Git-based CI pipelines; documented processes in Confluence for on-call and runbook use.

Ola — Apr 2021 - Apr 2023
Sales Manager (Field)
- Led B2B Sales initiatives for fleet and corporate partnerships, closing 30+ new accounts and increasing regional revenue by 22% year-over-year.
- Managed SFDC (Salesforce) pipeline and forecasting, improving forecast accuracy and shortening average deal cycle by 15%.
- Coordinated with operations and product teams to pilot promotions, tracked performance in Confluence and Git-hosted collateral, and optimized offer conversion rates by 18%.
- Trained and mentored a team of 6 sales executives on CRM best practices and B2B Sales strategies.

Projects
- CI/CD Playground: Built a reusable Git + Terraform + Ansible lab environment to demonstrate end-to-end deployment workflows; used for internal training and reduced onboarding time for new hires by ~40%.
- AKS Cost Optimizer: Scripted a PowerShell tool to analyze Azure monitor metrics and recommend node pool scaling and VM type changes, contributing to monthly cost reduction reports.

Skills
Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, PowerShell, Ansible, Linux, B2B Sales, SFDC, Git, Confluence
